title: Elysian Band — Classic
subtitle: The Elysian Cut™ set full circle — an elongated light that never closes.

stone.origin: Natural. Full eternity. Bez Ambar proprietary elongated cut.

description: The Elysian Cut™ — Bez Ambar's proprietary elongated form, poised between an oval and a baguette and shaped for a light neither one gives — set full circle in eighteen-karat white gold. At its classic proportion the stones strike the balance the cut was designed for: substantial enough to read across the room, fine enough to live on the hand daily. The eternity never breaks; the elongated light runs unbroken around the finger. Offered as a full band, with a halfway version available.
